### When the Urge to Escape Arrives

rows.label: Your answer 14: why trance-like is safer
rows.article: I went psychotic once on ayahuasca

beside.label: Your words, 02:18 UTC (14)
beside.text: 14. trance is safer specifically because you can't freak out when you're in trance. no matter how scary something is, it's just like "oh, this is scary, ok, oh well" and you're not really in the waking reality to even do anything, you can't scream, you can't call for help, it's almost like hypnagogia. so in that sense it could be "scarier" because you can't get help, but it's ultimately less scary in the way that ends up mattering. and yeah, that will prob confuse your readers even more lol.
